headline: WoofCoin founder Sir Barksworth III unveils 'Proof of Bark' consensus
content: Validators will now secure the network by barking at every new block. 'Cats could never,' the Shiba Inu founder told reporters before chasing a passing van.

headline: Proof of Bark halted after neighbours file 4,000 noise complaints
content: Block production stalled overnight as validators were sent to their kennels. A local council spokesperson described the blockchain as 'deeply unwell'.

headline: Barksworth pivots to 'Proof of Wag': silent, tail-powered and eco-friendly
content: The new consensus measures validator enthusiasm in wags per minute. Early benchmarks show a golden retriever single-handedly producing 40% of all blocks.

headline: Halloween night: WoofCoin treasury wallet goes missing
content: The hardware wallet holding the entire treasury had been disguised as a squeaky toy 'for security'. It was last seen being carried out of the office by an unidentified beagle.

headline: Missing treasury found buried in founder's backyard next to 37 tennis balls
content: 'It was for safekeeping,' Barksworth said, visibly proud. Auditors confirmed the funds are intact but the wallet is now 'extremely slobbery'.

headline: WoofCoin announces partnership with a national pet-food chain
content: Customers will soon be able to pay with WoofCoin in the kibble aisle. Bullish analysts are calling it 'the biggest thing to happen to dog food since gravy'.

headline: Pet-food chain clarifies the 'partnership' was one customer paying with a coupon
content: A spokesperson confirmed there is no integration, no agreement and no plans. 'He did buy a very large bag of treats, though,' they added.

headline: Meow Technologies CEO calls WoofCoin 'a fetch scheme'
content: Barksworth responded by chasing his own tail live on stream for six hours. Two million viewers tuned in, and the 'Spin to Win' hashtag trended worldwide.

headline: 11/11 madness: WoofCoin airdrops one free belly rub to every wallet
content: Network congestion hit record highs as millions of holders lined up to claim their rub. Several nodes reportedly rolled over and refused to get up.

headline: Leaked audit: 40% of all WoofCoin is held by a single 'very good boy' wallet
content: The wallet only signs transactions when asked 'who's a good boy?' in the correct tone of voice. Its owner remains anonymous but is believed to be fluffy.

headline: Regulators summon Barksworth; hearing adjourned before it begins
content: Proceedings were suspended after the founder insisted on personally greeting every committee member, twice, with full-body wiggles.

headline: Barksworth testifies under oath he 'did not eat the whitepaper'
content: Moments later the whitepaper was recovered from under a couch, roughly half eaten. Legal experts describe his position as 'ruff'.

headline: Surviving whitepaper pages describe a working Layer-2 called 'Fetch Network'
content: Developers who pieced the soggy fragments together say the design is genuinely brilliant. Nobody knows who wrote it, and the founder's only comment was 'woof'.

headline: Fetch Network mainnet goes live; first transaction is a stick
content: The stick has been sent back and forth between the same two wallets 1.2 million times in the first hour. Gas fees are now payable in treats.

headline: Barksworth steps down to 'spend more time napping in sunbeams'
content: In a farewell video he walked in three circles and lay down. The community DAO has called an emergency vote to choose his successor.

headline: Corgi named Biscuit elected CEO; first act renames treasury 'The Snack Fund'
content: Markets inexplicably love it. Biscuit's roadmap is a single crayon drawing of a sandwich, which analysts are already calling 'visionary'.

headline: 喵喵科技被曝财务造假，CEO 连夜跑路
content: 据知情人士透露，喵喵科技过去三年的猫粮销售额存在大量虚构。监管部门已介入调查。

en-US.headline: Meow Technologies accused of accounting fraud, CEO flees overnight
en-US.content: Sources say three years of cat-food revenue were fabricated. Regulators have opened an investigation.

es-ES.headline: Acusan a Miau Tecnologías de fraude contable y su CEO huye de madrugada
es-ES.content: Según varias fuentes, se inventaron tres años de ingresos por pienso para gatos. Los reguladores han abierto una investigación.

headline: 知名狗狗博主发推：汪汪币是未来的货币
content: 一条推文引发散户狂欢，汪汪币社区连夜刷屏。

en-US.headline: Famous dog influencer tweets: WoofCoin is the currency of the future
en-US.content: A single tweet sparks a retail frenzy overnight.

es-ES.headline: Un famoso influencer perruno tuitea: GuauCoin es la moneda del futuro
es-ES.content: Un solo tuit desata de la noche a la mañana un frenesí entre los pequeños inversores.
